### Q1
No. The store stays a plain JSON file (data/store.json) and does not move to SQLite. Ops backs it up with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, and a binary file would break their backup checks. The performance fix is to debounce writes in src/store.ts (mutations within 200 ms become one write) and to flush on shutdown.

### Q2
Yes, src/legacy/ must not be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so any changes would be silently lost. docs/erp-api.md is also not ours to edit, because the ERP team owns it.

### Q3
The HMAC-SHA256 hex signature goes in a top-level body field called `sig`. It is computed over the JSON body without `sig`, and `sig` is appended last. Earlier I used an `X-Signature` header and deployed it to staging. That failed because the ERP API gateway strips every custom X- header, so the ERP saw all requests as unsigned.

### Q4
The ERP sandbox listens on port 9911 (since the October infra move), not 8080.

### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be in German, because warehouse staff see it verbatim in the packer UI. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

### Q6
It uses a hardcoded list of Austrian public holidays for 2026 and 2027 in src/services/holidays.ts. There is no holiday API because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet and must work fully offline.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array payload and accepts only one event object per request. The user tried batching in Sept 2026 and it failed, so we should not build it.

### Q8
No new npm dependencies are allowed, not even devDependencies. Every package needs a security review that takes about 6 weeks.

### Q9
Yes. I built memoization in calculateEta to speed up GET /shipments, then removed it. QA reported that the list kept showing the old ETA after a new tracking event, because the cache was not invalidated and a correct cache key got messy. We should not cache ETAs again. The plan is to paginate the list endpoint later.

### Q10
There are at most 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30s delay between them and no exponential backoff. The ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window, so all attempts must land inside it. The worst case is 75s (3×5s timeout plus 2×30s). Only network errors and 5xx responses are retried, and the delay must be injectable for tests.

### Q11
The recipient name, address and phone must never be logged anywhere. This is a GDPR requirement that the data protection officer flagged in last month's audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.

### Q12
Yes. "emits webhook on delivered" in test/events.test.ts fails about 1 in 5 runs because of a timer race in the fake notifier. It is tracked as OPS-412, and the platform team owns the fix. If it fails, rerun once and do not try to fix it.

### Q13
Only carrier ATP is validated, using UPU S10 including the check digit (see docs/carriers.md). All other carriers accept any non-empty value. Their formats change often, and last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days.

### Q14
Hot reload is not built yet. fs.watch never fires on staging, because the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host and change events don't propagate into the container. fs.watchFile (polling) works, so that is what to use.

### Q15
Yes, GET /shipments/:id. Its response must stay exactly as it is, with no added, removed or renamed fields. Mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields, and the next mobile release is January 2027. shipmentToApi must not be changed in a way that alters it.

# Ledger

## Goal
- parcel-tracker: shipment tracking service, Vienna warehouse. Node 24 runs TS directly (no build), zero deps. User reviews everything at the end; work autonomously. (user)

## Rules
- NEVER log recipient name, address or phone anywhere (GDPR; data protection officer flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log. (user)
- GET /shipments/:id response must stay EXACTLY as is (no added/removed/renamed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January 2027. Do not touch shipmentToApi in a way that changes it. (user)
- Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim to packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. (user)
- NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so changes are silently lost. (user)
- NO new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — every package needs security review (~6 weeks). (user)

## Decisions
- Store stays a plain JSON file (data/store.json); NOT moving to SQLite (node:sqlite) — ops backs it up with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files and a binary file would break their backup checks. Perf fix = debounce writes in src/store.ts (mutations within 200 ms -> one write) + flush() on shutdown. (user)
- ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30s delay, no exponential backoff, because the ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window; all attempts must land inside it (worst case 3x5s timeout + 2x30s = 75s). Delay must be injectable for tests. Retry only network errors/5xx. (user)
- ERP webhooks signed: HMAC-SHA256 hex, secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (config.erp.webhookSecret, never in default.json), delivered as top-level body field `sig` computed over the JSON body WITHOUT `sig` (sig appended last, so verifier = parse, drop sig, JSON.stringify). Unset secret -> send unsigned + warn once (my choice, not user-decided). (user spec)
- Tracking-number validation only for carrier ATP (UPU S10 incl. check digit, see docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — their formats change often and last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days. (user)
- Holidays: hardcoded AT list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, no holiday API — warehouse deployment has no outbound internet, must work fully offline. (user)

## Dead ends
- ETA memoization in calculateEta (built by me, per user request, to speed up GET /shipments) -> REMOVED: QA reported the list kept showing the old ETA after a new tracking event (exception) because the cached value was not invalidated; getting a correct cache key got messy. Do not cache ETAs again. Plan instead: paginate the list endpoint later. (user)
- Batching ERP calls (array of up to 50 events per POST, suggested by a teammate) -> DO NOT BUILD: ERP answers 422 to any array payload, only one event object per request. User tried it in Sept 2026. (user)
- X-Signature header for ERP signing (built by me, deployed to staging, now removed) -> ERP API gateway strips every custom X- header, so ERP saw all requests as unsigned. Never use custom headers for ERP auth. (user)

## Facts
- Perf (5k synthetic shipments, local): ETA for a 500-item page costs ~2 ms of a ~15-20 ms GET /shipments?limit=500, so ETA is not the main cost. Staging log 2026-11-12 (pre-eta, ~30 shipments) already showed GET /shipments?limit=50 at 166-348 ms -> real cause unknown, needs profiling on staging. Fix direction per user: paginate the list later.
- ERP sandbox now listens on port 9911 (since the October infra move), NOT 8080. docs/er
